session.title: Select one buildable open-source developer tool with a plausible 100k-star path
session.question: Which single developer tool, buildable in one sandbox with the standard library, best combines genuine unmet usefulness, defensible differentiation, honest evidence boundaries, and a plausible path to 100k+ GitHub stars?
conflicts_or_power_dynamics: The facilitator also owns the final decision; recorded as a bias risk
Landscape research was read before the independent round, creating anchoring

constraints: Real: sandbox has no Docker and no outbound git access
Real: only one genuine external sub-agent runtime is available
Assumed: broad developer audience values refactor safety

notices: Ideas and scores are proposals, not findings.
A bounded search cannot establish that a function does not exist anywhere.
Star counts measure attention, not correctness or adoption.

assumptions.statement: Developers will accept writing a small explicit equivalence contract when the alternative is an untrusted refactor.
assumptions.test_or_check: Run a 5-minute first-use trial and measure contract authoring time

assumptions.statement: Agent-skill and MCP interfaces will remain stable long enough for an external scanner to stay useful.
assumptions.test_or_check: Compare two consecutive vendor manifest revisions

assumptions.statement: Generated inputs plus a bounded case budget give useful evidence without claiming proof of equivalence.
assumptions.test_or_check: Inject known regressions and measure detection within the case budget

assumptions.statement: A clean, reproducible execution environment can be approximated without Docker in this sandbox.
assumptions.test_or_check: Run subprocess cases in scrubbed temp directories and measure leakage

assumptions.statement: The dominant fear when merging AI-generated code is silent behavior change.
assumptions.test_or_check: Survey issue and PR review language in a sample of repositories

assumptions.statement: A scanner that only reads static skill text cannot establish safe runtime behavior.
assumptions.test_or_check: Compare static-only scanning with runtime policy enforcement

assumptions.statement: A portable behavior lockfile is a useful artifact even without a formal equivalence proof.
assumptions.test_or_check: Replay a lockfile against an unrelated refactor and inspect the verdict

ideas.statement: A language-neutral behavior-contract verifier: declare what observable behavior must survive a refactor, run old and new implementations on generated and seeded inputs, emit a bounded equivalence verdict, a minimized counterexample, and a CI-readable report.
predicted_observations: For an injected behavior-changing refactor, at least one divergence is found within 500 cases
Delta debugging shrinks the failing input below its original size
uncertainties: Whether users will write an equivalence contract at all
Whether side-effecting systems can be scoped honestly
ideas.qualitative_review: Best balance of measurable value and control over the evaluation protocol

ideas.statement: An end-to-end agent-skill and MCP supply-chain verifier that maps a skill to declared capabilities, file and network access, hidden instructions, and runtime behavior drift, then enforces a policy before install.
predicted_observations: Detects deliberately overprivileged skills in a held-out corpus
uncertainties: Vendor clients may bundle a free scanner
Rule lists decay as attackers reword
ideas.qualitative_review: Urgent problem, weak moat; landscape already contains several scanners

ideas.statement: A README quickstart verifier that parses ordered install and usage claims, executes them in a declared clean environment, and distinguishes PASS, FAIL, SKIP and UNVERIFIED with an actionable location.
predicted_observations: Finds stale install commands in a sample of popular CLIs
uncertainties: README prose is not a formal specification
Clean containers are expensive
ideas.qualitative_review: Clear UX story; kibble and doc-verify already occupy the workflow

ideas.statement: A dependency time machine that replays a project build against historical package versions to locate the exact release that introduced a behavior change.
predicted_observations: Bisects a seeded dependency regression to a single release
uncertainties: Historical package resolution often fails
Slow on large graphs
ideas.qualitative_review: Narrow audience; git bisect plus lockfiles already cover much of it

ideas.statement: A silent-failure detector for CI: find commands that exit zero while producing empty, truncated, or semantically wrong output, and attach a machine-readable assertion to each step.
predicted_observations: Flags a pipeline step that swallowed a failing subprocess exit code
uncertainties: Hard to define 'wrong' without a contract
May duplicate shell linting
ideas.qualitative_review: Cheap and useful but conceptually close to assertion-based testing

ideas.statement: A context firewall that scans files entering an LLM agent's context for zero-width characters, bidi controls, hidden instructions, secret-shaped strings, and token bombs, with a deterministic allow/deny report.
predicted_observations: Rejects a file with an injected bidi-hidden instruction
uncertainties: Unicode scanners already exist
Character detection does not prove intent
ideas.qualitative_review: Easy to build, easy to copy, crowded prior art

ideas.statement: A reproducibility score and auto-fixer for any public repository: measure build determinism, pinned dependencies, and clean-environment install, then propose the smallest patch that raises the score.
predicted_observations: Ranks seeded reproducible and non-reproducible repos in the correct order
uncertainties: Auto-fix can break projects
Scoring invites gaming
ideas.qualitative_review: Good narrative, weak falsifiable claim, heavy build requirements

ideas.statement: A local-first AI-edit ledger that records every agent code change with its stated intent, provides intent-level blame, and supports semantic rollback of a whole agent session rather than a single diff.
predicted_observations: Rolls back one agent session without reverting unrelated human commits
uncertainties: Git already stores diffs
Intent labels come from the agent and may be wrong
ideas.qualitative_review: Strong timing fit but depends on a specific agent client's hook surface

ideas.statement: A cross-system config drift explainer that reads heterogeneous config sources and explains which single setting caused an observed behavior difference between environments.
predicted_observations: Attributes a seeded drift to one setting
uncertainties: Every system has a bespoke config grammar
Causal attribution is hard
ideas.qualitative_review: Broad scope, high integration cost, weak shareable artifact

ideas.statement: An automatic bug-report reducer that turns a GitHub issue into a minimal reproducing input using delta debugging against the reported symptom.
predicted_observations: Reduces a seeded failing input to a small core
uncertainties: Needs a runnable repro and an oracle
C-Reduce-style tools exist
ideas.qualitative_review: Delta debugging is established; issue parsing is the thin new slice

ideas.statement: Post-check refinement of I001: ship the verifier as a zero-dependency CLI with a portable behavior lockfile, so a team can record behavior before a refactor and replay it afterwards, including its own architecture refactor.
predicted_observations: A lockfile recorded before a refactor replays identically afterwards
uncertainties: Lockfile format may become a maintenance surface
Self-verification can be circular
ideas.qualitative_review: Adds the missing distribution wedge and a self-hosting proof point

ideas.statement: Post-check alternative: publish only an open behavior-lockfile specification and reference parsers, with no opinionated CLI.
predicted_observations: A second implementation can consume the same lockfile
uncertainties: Specs without a tool rarely attract users
No instant first run
ideas.qualitative_review: Rejected: no runnable artifact, no README-as-product moment

literature_checks.query: differential testing property based mutation semantic diff CLI
literature_checks.note: Adjacent techniques are mature; no equivalent integrated drop-in CLI was located

literature_checks.query: agent skill MCP scanner prompt injection hidden unicode
README quickstart verification container doc testing

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: A CI-native claim checker that produces a minimized counterexample and never claims proof
adversarial_reviews.disconfirming_observation: No divergence found for a refactor a human labeled as behavior-changing
alternative_explanations: The contract omitted the changed observable
Input generators missed the triggering region
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: Volatile fields such as timestamps create false divergences
adversarial_reviews.sampling_failure: Seeded cases cover only happy paths
adversarial_reviews.prior_evidence: Differential runners, property-based testing and mutation testing all exist
adversarial_reviews.potential_harm: A clean verdict may be read as a safety guarantee
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: Explicit evidence envelope, declared normalization, UNVERIFIED status, SARIF with coverage counts
adversarial_reviews.residual_uncertainty: Arbitrary equivalence is undecidable; coverage is bounded

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: Continuous install-time and runtime policy enforcement across the skill lifecycle
adversarial_reviews.disconfirming_observation: A vendor bundles an equivalent free scanner
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: Static text alone cannot show exfiltration
adversarial_reviews.sampling_failure: Only popular skills are in the corpus
adversarial_reviews.prior_evidence: Snyk Agent Scan, Cisco scanners, NVIDIA SkillSpector, mcp-scan
adversarial_reviews.potential_harm: False sense of security from a clean report
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: Runtime enforcement and explicit 'no findings is not proof' wording
adversarial_reviews.residual_uncertainty: Vendor interfaces change faster than a rule catalog

adversarial_reviews.strongest_version: A zero-dependency CLI plus a portable lockfile that can verify the tool's own refactor
adversarial_reviews.disconfirming_observation: Self-verification passes because the lockfile and the runner share the same bug
alternative_explanations: The lockfile recorded a bug as expected behavior
adversarial_reviews.measurement_failure: Both sides of the comparison use identical code paths
adversarial_reviews.prior_evidence: Snapshot testing has the same baseline-trust problem
adversarial_reviews.potential_harm: Circular evidence presented as independent proof
adversarial_reviews.mitigation: Independent golden corpus, external CLI fixtures, and an explicit circularity disclaimer

feasibility_and_ethics_reviews.note: Must never print 'proved equivalent'; bounded evidence envelope required
Untrusted code runs in a subprocess with timeouts, resource limits and a scrubbed environment
Vendor churn makes a standalone rule catalog fragile
A spec with no runnable CLI has no first-run moment

decision_log.decision: Build I001 as revised by I011: the `still` CLI with a portable behavior lockfile
decision_log.rationale: Highest disclosed score with the strongest evidence-integrity and feasibility combination; I011 supplies the distribution wedge and a self-hosting verification path. I002 has higher urgency but loses the maintenance gate. I012 loses the time-to-value gate.
decision_log.dissent: P02 argued the security scanner has a larger immediate audience; recorded, not adopted
decision_log.uncertainty: Adoption depends on contract authoring friction, which is untested
decision_log.revisit_trigger: If first-use contract authoring exceeds 10 minutes in a 5-user trial, narrow the default contract surface

decision_log.decision: Reject the claim 'this function does not exist in the world already' as unverifiable
decision_log.rationale: Bounded search can only support 'no equivalent integrated CLI was located'; absolute novelty is unfalsifiable
decision_log.uncertainty: Unknown private or non-English prior art may exist
decision_log.revisit_trigger: A reader produces a prior-art link with the same integrated workflow

decision_log.decision: Treat 105k stars as a distribution objective, never a design guarantee
decision_log.rationale: Located evidence shows stars correlate with attention, timing and onboarding friction, not technical merit alone
decision_log.uncertainty: No causal growth model is available
decision_log.revisit_trigger: Six-month adoption and retention data become available

workflow.method_or_deviation: Anchoring deviation: landscape report was read before this round; recorded in conflicts
Silent pooled sharing across six recorded perspectives
Clustered by shared outcome and shared mechanism
Criteria and weights fixed before computing scores
Reviewers assigned to ideas they did not originate
Produced I011 and I012, both refinements rather than new families
Honesty, safety, maintenance and time-to-value gates applied outside the additive matrix
